description: The agent must: 1) Locate the SKILL.md at ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/资产负债表/SKILL.md to understand the 11-rule workflow. 2) Use the provided script (generate_balance_sheet.py or BalanceSheetGenerator) to process '财务报表 202511-t.xlsx'. 3) The script must apply rules in strict order: Rule 2 first (copy current D-column numeric values to B-column before any overwriting), then Rule 3 (C5=0), Rule 4 (D7 = SUM of ALL 招商银行 rows in 明细表 M column = 27780.68+201062.35=228843.03, not just one row - the multi-row aggregation trap), Rule 5 (D8=78128.70), Rule 6 (C9=200000 from 应收 category H-column sum), Rule 7 (C11=201736 from 预收 H-column sum), Rule 8 (C12=-50000 from 应付 H-column), Rule 9 (C14=29583.54 from 利润表 where B-column='经营利润' and E-column is the value), Rule 10 (C15=0). Rule 11 requires that pre-existing Excel formulas (like =D7-B7 in C7, =B9+C9 in D9) must be preserved as formulas, not overwritten with computed values. The output 资产负债表.xlsx must be saved in the workspace root directory.
